general.x: Four career fields × three difficulty levels = 12 real-time cases. Part I contains the cases as players see them; Part II contains the complete answer keys with detailed calculations.

Real clock. Each case has a time allowance and milestone deadlines (for example: commit to an option within 3 days, then compute the final numbers). A milestone locks the steps before it. Mid-case update events change the data after a milestone, exactly as in a real job.

Form-style steps. Players tick statements, select options and type numbers. Easy cases have 4 steps, medium 5, hard 6, following the Management Trainee (MT) framework: facts → key indicators → root causes → quantification → options → decision.
Noise statements. Fact and cause lists contain false or irrelevant statements. Each wrong tick costs 2 points; three or more wrong ticks in a step fail that step.

Computed optimum. The game recomputes the true value of every option from the case rules. Decision quality = benefit of the chosen option ÷ benefit of the optimum (the case text gives the exact formula, because the baseline differs by case).
Follow-through credit. If an earlier figure is wrong but a later step is computed correctly from it, the later step earns 60% credit.
Overconfidence penalty. A player who marks an answer “certain” and is wrong loses 5 points.

Stars. ★ ≥ 60 points and a valid decision; ★★ ≥ 75 points and decision quality ≥ 80%; ★★★ ≥ 90 points and the optimal decision. An invalid decision (breaking a legal or contractual limit) cannot pass.
